units.source_text: 仲夏时节，户外阳光璀璨。

en.t: In midsummer, the sunlight outdoors was dazzling.

units.source_text: 在逆光映照下的室内，名人的身影显得更加暗淡凄怆。

en.t: Inside the room, lit from behind by the glare, the Master’s figure looked still darker and more sorrowful.

units.source_text: 对局室的人都耷拉了脑袋，谁也没去看一眼名人。

en.t: Everyone in the playing room hung their heads, and no one so much as glanced at the Master.

units.source_text: 今天，平素爱说俏皮话的大竹七段也缄口不言。

en.t: Today even Otake, the seventh-dan player who usually liked making witty remarks, kept silent.
